explainer.title: Understanding environmental data
explainer.description: Learn about the indicators used by CTRLCLIMA and understand what each one reveals about a region's environmental conditions.

airTemperature.title: Air temperature
airTemperature.description: Represents air temperature measured approximately 2 meters above the Earth's surface. It is expressed in degrees Celsius.

maximumTemperature.title: Maximum temperature
maximumTemperature.description: Indicates the highest air temperature recorded during each day, measured at a height of 2 meters.

minimumTemperature.title: Minimum temperature
minimumTemperature.description: Indicates the lowest air temperature recorded during each day, measured at a height of 2 meters.

precipitation.title: Precipitation
precipitation.description: Represents the estimated accumulated rainfall, expressed in millimeters per day.

humidity.title: Relative humidity
humidity.description: Indicates the amount of water vapor in the air relative to the maximum amount it could hold at that temperature.

wind.title: Wind speed
wind.description: Represents wind speed measured approximately 2 meters above the surface, generally expressed in meters per second.

difference.title: Air temperature is not surface temperature
difference.description: Air temperature, measured 2 meters above the ground, differs from land surface temperature. Asphalt, rooftops and areas without vegetation can reach surface temperatures much higher than the surrounding air. These indicators should not be interpreted as the same measurement.

reportGuide.title: How to interpret the reports?
reportGuide.description: CTRLCLIMA reports organize environmental data for the selected location and period to facilitate analysis.
reportGuide.period: Shows the dates used in the query and defines the interval of the presented data.
reportGuide.location: Presents the region and geographic coordinates of the queried point.
reportGuide.indicators: Gathers information on temperature, precipitation, humidity and wind.
reportGuide.charts: Allow users to observe indicator variations and compare different periods.
reportGuide.source: Identifies NASA AppEEARS / Giovanni as the source of the environmental data used.
reportGuide.export: The PDF gathers analysis information for consultation, printing or sharing.
reportGuide.note: Important: Data represents estimates and records provided by the source for the queried location and period. An observed variation alone does not prove the cause of a climate phenomenon.

reports.aboutData: Values are provided by NASA AppEEARS / Giovanni and may represent meteorological model estimates or satellite-derived data. The TS variable corresponds to model surface temperature and should not be confused with a direct measurement of land surface temperature by an orbital sensor (LST).

app.heroDescription: Earth science data translated into clear information about environmental change, exposure and population health.
app.exploreTitle: Explore a region of the planet
app.exploreDescription: Choose a country, state and city. Queries use the coordinates of the selected location.
app.mapHint: Select a location in the panel beside it.
app.extractDescription: CTRLClima tracks processing in the background and automatically loads the CSV when NASA completes the task. Use this source for MODIS land-surface temperature (LST), not air temperature.
app.selectFirst: First select a location with coordinates.
app.taskSentNoId: Request submitted. Check the AppEEARS response.
app.taskError: Could not submit extraction. Check the backend and Earthdata credentials.
app.healthDescription: Risk depends on the environmental hazard, who is exposed and the conditions of vulnerability.
app.heatText: Heat exposure can cause heat stress, exhaustion and heatstroke, and worsen cardiovascular, respiratory and kidney diseases and diabetes.
app.vegetationText: Changes in vegetation and land cover help contextualize cooling capacity and environmental transformations.
app.vulnerabilityText: Age, health status, occupation, housing, income and access to cooling influence heat vulnerability.
app.indicatorsText: Aggregated hospitalization and mortality data can be analyzed alongside environmental series when compatible official data are available.
app.healthNote: CTRLClima provides scientific context and may support population studies. Land surface temperature is not air temperature and does not directly measure individual exposure. Statistical association does not prove causality. The platform does not provide diagnosis or medical alerts.
app.whoLink: WHO guidance on heat and health
app.trendTitle: What changed and what may come next
app.trendDescription: Observed history and exploratory projection are presented separately.
app.trendEmpty: Import a CSV with real data exported from AppEEARS or Giovanni. Use year;value columns. No synthetic observations are displayed.
app.chartDescription: Statistical estimate calculated from the imported series. It is not an official climate forecast.
app.needData: Import a CSV with years and values to calculate a projection.
app.projectionNote: Linear projection is exploratory only. Robust climate projections require documented models, scenarios and uncertainties. The chart uses only the series you import.
app.csvImported: {{count}} records imported. Check that the first column is year and the second is the indicator.
app.csvInvalid: Could not recognize the data. Use a CSV with a header and year;value columns.
app.reportsDescription: Export imported data or generate a print/PDF version.
app.reportText: Includes location, methodology, sources and limitations.
app.noSeries: No historical series has been imported.
app.sourcesTitle: Where does the information come from?
app.sourcesDescription: Each indicator should report source, period, spatial scale, quality and limitations.
app.sourceAppeears: Extraction of geospatial observations by point or area, with quality layers.
app.sourceGiovanni: Time series and scientific analyses of products provided by NASA GES DISC.
app.sourceIbge: Territorial and demographic context for interpreting population exposure.
app.sourceDatasus: Aggregated public-health indicators when available and suitable for the selected area.
app.sourceWho: Scientific guidance on climate, heat and health.
app.observationText: Satellite data represent a specific product, spatial resolution and observation period. Land surface temperature (LST) is not the same as air temperature (T2M).
app.historyText: Describes patterns in the observed series and depends on temporal coverage, data quality and consistency.
app.projectionText: An estimate conditioned by method, assumptions and uncertainty. It is not certainty or a daily weather forecast.
app.healthText: Aggregated indicators require context, time lags, confounder control and expert validation.
app.footer: Accessible environmental knowledge for a more prepared society.
app.sourcesLine: Resources: NASA AppEEARS · Giovanni · Hydrology Time Series · NOAA CDO · KNMI · SeaWiFS · CSA RADARSAT · SWOT · WHO
app.giovanniTitle: Query a NASA Giovanni time series
app.giovanniDescription: The official variable catalog loads automatically. Select a variable to query the NASA time series for the chosen coordinates and period; interpretable results feed the charts and analysis.
app.giovanniPlaceholder: Example: identifier listed in the catalog
app.giovanniResult: Response received from NASA Giovanni. Check metadata before interpreting values.
app.taskDone: NASA processing is complete. Review the bundle files to download the data.
app.taskFailed: NASA reported that task processing failed.
app.taskQueued: NASA accepted the task and it is waiting for processing.
app.taskNoId: NASA accepted the request but did not return a recognizable task identifier.
app.dateError: Enter a valid period: the start date must be on or before the end date.
app.earthdataConfigured: Earthdata credentials are configured on the backend.
app.earthdataMissing: Configure Earthdata credentials in the backend .env file.
app.apiUnavailable: Could not connect to the backend. Start the API on port 3000.
app.healthDataStatus: DATASUS and IBGE data are not yet connected to calculate local indicators. In this version, the panel provides scientific context about heat, not a quantitative estimate of hospitalizations, mortality or individual risk.
app.giovanniEyebrow: NASA GES DISC · GIOVANNI IN THE CLOUD
app.qcApplied: Only MODIS observations with good mandatory QA and data-quality flags were retained.
app.giovanniCatalogReady: {{count}} variables available in the retrieved catalog.
app.giovanniCatalogError: The catalog could not be loaded right now. You can manually enter an official identifier.
app.giovanniCatalogEmpty: The catalog responded, but its identifiers could not be recognized. Check the official catalog or enter an identifier manually.
app.giovanniNoParsedSeries: The response was received, but its format was not recognized as a tabular time series. The original response was preserved for inspection.
app.taskDataLoaded: Real AppEEARS data loaded: {{count}} annual values aggregated from the downloaded file.
app.olsCiNote: Approximate interval for the linear slope
app.statisticsCaveat: Calculated from {{count}} annual observations between {{first}} and {{last}}. The Mann–Kendall test uses a normal approximation and does not correct for seasonality or autocorrelation; interpret with caution.
app.sourceHydrology: NASA GES DISC tool for generating time series of hydrological variables. Complementary resource; automated integration is not enabled in this version.
app.sourceNoaa: Global historical climate and weather-station archive. Complementary source; not connected as an API in this version.
app.sourceSeaWiFS: Technical reference paper on building time series and testing statistical significance.
app.sourceKnmi: Scientific tool for exploring and comparing climate data. Used as a complementary methodological resource.
app.sourceTrendMethods: Further reading on statistical methods for identifying trends in time series.
app.sourceSignificance: Reference material for interpreting statistical significance and avoiding overstated conclusions.
app.sourceRadarsat: Canadian radar data for maritime, disaster-management and ecosystem-monitoring applications. Complementary source, not automatically integrated.
app.sourceGeo: Canadian open geospatial-data portal for environmental and territorial studies.
app.sourceSwot: Surface-water observation mission with data on rivers, lakes, reservoirs and oceans.
app.sourceEcosystem: Resource about using space-based observations to monitor change and protect ecosystems.
app.qcMissing: No matching QC column was found in the file; values were not quality-filtered.
